name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Oberdaxenbichl
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Oberdaxenbichl is located in Schwoich, a village in the Tyrolean Unterland near Kufstein. The holiday apartment is part of an active agricultural farm and enjoys a quiet hillside setting with panoramic views of the Kaisergebirge mountains. The accommodation is fully set up for self-catering. Guests are welcome to use the farm grounds with its animals and garden. Hiking trails start directly at the doorstep.
